doc_title: APPLICATION FOR PARTITION PURSUANT TO AN ORDER OF THE REGISTRAR
doc_title_official: APPLICATION FOR PARTITION PURSUANT TO AN ORDER OF THE REGISTRAR
when_used: Tenants in common apply for the land to be partitioned in the manner a court order or an order of the Registrar directs.

body_text.text: Name of the applicant(s) the tenant(s) in common of the land comprised in the above-mentioned Title.
The applicant(s) HEREBY apply to the Registrar for the land to be partitioned in accordance to the Court order as follows:

foot_notes: *Give details of all the tenants : name; PIN; ID/Passport No.; and Address **Delete whichever is not applicable.
***The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”
**** Attach a Cadastral Map and a Cadastral Plan.

custom_fields.name: tenants_details
custom_fields.label: Details of all the tenants
custom_fields.prompt: For every tenant in common: name, PIN, ID or Passport number and address, numbered 1, 2 and 3 as the form prints them

custom_fields.name: applicant_names
custom_fields.label: Name of the applicant(s)
custom_fields.prompt: Full names of the tenants in common making this application

custom_fields.name: partition_schedule
custom_fields.label: How the land is to be partitioned
custom_fields.prompt: The parcels as the order directs them to stand after the partition. One parcel per line, the cells separated by a pipe: cadastral plan number | title number | area (approximately) | proprietor
